title: Algotion application log event
description: One event as written on stdout and accepted by POST {ALGOSTATUS_LOG_URL}/api/log/ingest. The server rejects ai_* projects by credential. The client libs always send the same shape on stdout and in the batch.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, milliseconds recommended. The server clamps values outside +/-24h instead of rejecting them.

level.description: Severity. The server also accepts the aliases 'warning' and 'critical'; the clients emit the canonical spelling.

event.description: Low-cardinality dotted code, e.g. app.start, db.error, heartbeat. Defaults to 'log' when absent.

msg.description: Human-readable message, 1..2000 characters. Truncated by the clients; an empty message falls back to the event code.

project.description: Repo name in the algosolltd org. Optional here because a token bound to a project (LOG_PER_PROJECT_TOKENS) decides it; ai_* is rejected by credential and by allowlist.

platform.description: Where the process runs: railway, kraken-1, laptop. Client default: unknown.

source.description: Internal part that emitted the event: http, worker, strategy, deploy. Client default: app.

data.description: Structured payload, max 4096 serialized bytes. The clients replace anything larger with {"truncated":true}. For a heartbeat it carries heartbeat_s, dropped and queued.

trace_id.description: Correlation id, truncated to 120 characters by the clients.

actor.description: Agent or person, truncated to 80 characters by the clients.

dedupe_key.description: Optional idempotency key. The clients use hb:<project>:<platform>:<source>:<epoch minute> for heartbeats and omit it otherwise.

dropped.description: Events dropped by the bounded queue since start.

then.description: A heartbeat updates ops_source.last_seen and is not stored as a log row.
